concepts.gloss_en: The desire/lust for money itself (the trait)

members.note: the bare concept — the desire itself, not any action upon it

concepts.gloss_en: The breaking of the desire for money (an action, not the desire itself)

members.note: construct head שבירה (breaking) — action about the trait, distinct from the trait per rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: The desire for money being rectified (rectification-action; head תיקון/נתתקן, distinct from the 'breaking' action)

members.note: verb head נתתקן (rectified); different action head from שבירה and from the bare trait

concepts.gloss_en: Menstrual blood being rectified, [identified with] the desire for money — a distinct compound about tikkun of dam nidah

members.note: primary head is דם נדה being rectified; taavat mamon appears only as an apposition — distinct construct/subject per rule 4

notes: All four kept separate: the bare trait (תאות ממון) vs. actions upon it with different heads (שבירה vs נתתקן) vs. a compound whose primary subject is דם נדה. Note the שבירת proof itself uses תיקון interchangeably, but different action heads are kept distinct per the protocol (under-merge beats over-merge).
